segments.text: Hello, now I would like to show you on how to generate flashcards in NotebookLM.
On the right hand side, you should see the Studio section.
If you are an owner or an editor of the file, you should see several options that you can
One of it is the flashcards option.
So if you click on it, it will generate flashcards on your NotebookLM accordingly.
And you can click on the pencil icon to customize the settings such as fewer cards, more, or
And you can click on the generate button to use those settings accordingly to generate
This is an example of the flashcards related in this NotebookLM file.
So you can click the next button or the previous button to see the previous flashcard.
And you can click on the see answer option here to see the answer of it.
And you can click the explain button to explain the flashcard and it will appear on the chat.
